added: Signed-in users can send optional app feedback from the current shell with a separate form and a confirmed feedback reference.
changed: Persona evidence includes three historical local-browser form cases and current automated HTTP/MCP expiry and form regressions; human satisfaction, confusion and frustration are NOT MEASURED.
fixed: Entered feedback survives refused or uncertain submissions; the form requests authenticated attribution at the actual write boundary instead of relying on cached sign-in.
security: Optional require_authenticated on the existing HTTP/MCP feedback write refuses anonymous callers before persistence when true; omission or false preserves public feedback. No database migration or automatic context capture.
